case.title: Preparedness 101: Zombie Pandemic
case.author: Maggie Silver, James Archer, Bob Hobbs, Alissa Eckert and Mark Conner; CDC
case.provenance: Owner-supplied PDF. CDC Stacks record links this PDF and supplies the matching SHA-512.
case.rightsBasis: CDC Stacks declares Public Domain. Attribution retained; document is not relicensed under MIT.

rightsClearance.scope: CDC Stacks Public Domain declaration; no new owner confirmation or shipped-catalog admission.

case.reviewStatus: EPUBCheck, progress and 512 MiB Mac RSS gate pass. Source and comparison spot checks expose damaged inherited dialogue on page 5 and fresh-OCR panel ordering on page 13. Whole-comic fidelity is unqualified.

ownerReportedFindings.finding: Approximately 2000 extracted words across 42 pages; dialogue is part of the artwork.
ownerReportedFindings.status: Owner-reported estimate; independent pypdf 6.10.0 extraction yields 3341 whitespace-delimited tokens, including damaged OCR, not a reliable dialogue word count.

memoryBudget.scope: macOS 27 arm64 isolated release CLI, defaults; initial RSS regression ceiling, not a mobile device budget

case.downloadVerification: Publisher SHA-512 matches owner-supplied original; automatic fresh fetch returns HTTP 403. Seed the ignored cache manually; tools/fetch_corpus.py verifies exact bytes offline. See measurements/cdc-zombie-pandemic-2011/download-status.json.

knownFidelityIssues.issue: Damaged existing text and omitted small balloon survive without a suspect-text warning; complete artwork is present as an image.
Fresh OCR places lower-left panel dialogue before upper-right dialogue and promotes speech to headings.

measurementScope: One process run; RSS excludes separate Apple services. Timing excludes validation. Not a latency distribution or physical mobile-device measurement.

progressCheck.scope: CLI work fraction, page bounds and completion; not elapsed-time prediction
